messages.content: Delta changed our Sunday flight home from Nashville. It now leaves at 11:50 a.m., which conflicts with the anniversary brunch. Can you check the change options for both of us without touching Friday's flight?

Yes. I found the schedule notice on confirmation H6R2VN for Avery Thompson and Jordan Lee. The Friday, November 20 outbound remains confirmed at 6:35 p.m. Eastern from Atlanta, arriving Nashville at 6:48 p.m. Central. I’ll leave that segment unchanged and review only Sunday, November 22.
The brunch should finish around 2:00. We need enough time to get to the airport afterward.

Delta is offering a schedule-change waiver for both passengers. Two practical Sunday alternatives are available: a 3:20 p.m. Central departure connecting in Detroit and arriving Atlanta at 8:08 p.m. Eastern, or a nonstop departing at 6:35 p.m. Central and arriving at 8:47 p.m. Eastern.
What would each one add to what we already paid?

The 3:20 p.m. connecting itinerary can be reissued at no additional charge under the waiver, so the ticket total would remain $672 for both travelers. The 6:35 p.m. nonstop has a combined fare difference of $84, making the revised flight total $756. There is no separate change fee for either option.
How long is the connection, and does that 3:20 option really get us in only about forty minutes before the nonstop?

Correct. The connecting option reaches Detroit at 5:52 p.m. Eastern, has a 58-minute layover, then departs at 6:50 p.m. and arrives in Atlanta at 8:08 p.m. The nonstop leaves Nashville more than three hours later but arrives at 8:47 p.m., just 39 minutes after the connecting itinerary.
Then the connection does not buy us much. Are seats together available on the evening nonstop for both of us?
Yes. There are adjacent Main Cabin seats available for both travelers on the 6:35 p.m. nonstop. Your existing tickets remain in Main Cabin, and the change would apply to the Sunday return only.
Before you change it, confirm that the airline will move both tickets together and that our Friday seats and flight remain exactly as booked.

Confirmed. Both Sunday tickets can be reissued in the same transaction. The Friday 6:35 p.m. Atlanta-to-Nashville flight, its assigned seats, and the confirmation number will remain unchanged. Only the Sunday return segment will be replaced.
All right. Reissue both of us on the 6:35 Sunday nonstop for the additional $84.

The change is ready to submit for a new airfare total of $756 for two passengers, which is $84 more than the original $672. The Sunday flight will depart Nashville at 6:35 p.m. Central and arrive Atlanta at 8:47 p.m. Eastern. Shall I finalize the reissue?

Reissued successfully for Avery Thompson and Jordan Lee under the existing Delta confirmation H6R2VN. The Friday, November 20 outbound remains unchanged at 6:35 p.m. Eastern. The new Sunday, November 22 return is the 6:35 p.m. Central nonstop from Nashville, arriving Atlanta at 8:47 p.m. Eastern, with adjacent Main Cabin seats assigned. The additional charge is $84, bringing the flight total to $756. The Hilton Nashville Green Hills reservation remains unchanged at $506.14, so the revised complete trip total is $1,262.14. Nothing else is pending.
